description: Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]: volcanic hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. Coverage: Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about volcanic hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Mapa de peligros. Tipología eruptiva. Cartografía de peligrosidad volc; Mapa de centro eruptivos. Cartografía de peligrosidad volcánica de la ; Mapa de unidades volcanológicas. Cartografía de peligrosidad volcánica; Mapa de estructura territorial. Cartografía de peligrosidad volcánica . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.igme.es/condiciones-de-uso/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
